cell_type.evidence: We utilized the proximity-labeling system TurboID to achieve global and unbiased labeling of proteins within GBM-derived EVs. By inducing TurboID expression in primary-cultured human BTICs from GBM patients, we achieved efficient biotinylation of EV proteins without compromising vesicle integrity, and performed proteomic analysis of biotinylated proteins, which revealed a diverse cargo within BTIC-EVs.
